description: Enhanced workspace tabs (drag-drop reorder, drag between panes, middle-click close, starred/bookmarked tabs) and comprehensive settings modal matching Obsidian's preferences
steps: 1. In src/components/workspace/EditorLeaf.tsx TabChip component, add drag-drop support for tab reordering within a leaf. Use HTML5 drag events. On drag start, store the tab fileId. On drag over another tab, show an insertion indicator. On drop, reorder the tabs array in the workspace tree via a new reorderTabsInLeaf() function in src/lib/workspace/tree.ts.

2. Add cross-pane tab dragging: when a tab is dragged outside its parent tab strip and dropped onto another leaf (or a drop zone in the workspace), move that tab to the target leaf. Use the existing moveLeaf infrastructure or add a moveTab(fromLeafId, toLeafId, fileId) action to the vault store.
3. Add middle-click to close tabs: in the TabChip component, handle onAuxClick (button === 1) to close the tab. This matches Obsidian and browser behavior.

4. Expand the Settings modal (src/components/settings/SettingsModal.tsx) to include multiple sections matching Obsidian's preferences: (a) Editor section: font size, line width (narrow/medium/wide), show line numbers toggle, readable line length toggle, spell check toggle, indent size (2/4 spaces/tab). (b) Files section: default new note location, attachment folder path, deleted files behavior (trash/permanent). (c) Appearance section: current theme toggle plus accent color picker (5-6 preset accent colors that update --primary CSS variable). (d) Hotkeys section: list all registered commands with their current hotkey, allow clicking to rebind (using setHotkeyOverride from hotkeys.ts). Store settings in a new settings-store.ts (Zustand + localStorage persistence).

5. Create src/lib/settings/settings-store.ts with all editor/file/appearance settings, persisted to localStorage. Apply editor settings (font size, line numbers, line width) by passing them through to CodeMirror extensions dynamically. Apply appearance settings by updating CSS custom properties on document.documentElement.

6. Wire the settings into CodeMirrorEditor: the buildExtensions function should accept settings (fontSize, showLineNumbers, tabSize, lineWidth) and configure the extensions accordingly. Since the editor uses mount-once pattern, use EditorView.reconfigure compartments to swap extensions dynamically when settings change.

7. Add a 'Starred notes' / bookmarks feature: users can star/bookmark notes (stored in the settings store). Show starred notes in a collapsible section at the top of the left sidebar, above the file tree. Add 'Star this note' to the context menu and as a command.
acceptance_criteria: Tabs can be reordered within a pane via drag-drop
Settings modal has Editor, Files, Appearance, and Hotkeys sections
Changing font size in settings immediately updates the editor
Hotkeys can be rebound in settings
Accent color changes update the UI theme immediately
Starred notes appear in the left sidebar
